content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Devon: finally home ugh
Me: same, just kicked my shoes off
Devon: 5th was stupid again
Me: by the bank again?
Devon: yep cones everywhere still
Me: i cut through by oak and it was still slow
Devon: should've done that, i just sat through it like an idiot
Me: cat was already on the clean laundry when i walked in
Devon: of course, tradition
Me: literally only the clean load, never dirty
Devon: zero chill forever
Me: did you eat yet
Devon: not yet, probably just toast again
Me: peanut butter era continues
Devon: fr, elite fallback
Me: i heated up soup again, trying to finish it before it goes bad
Devon: the tomato one?
Me: yeah from last week, it's on its last legs lol
Devon: better than my toast rotation
Me: hey did your sweatshirt ever stop smelling like smoke
Devon: lol no, washed it and i can still kinda smell campfire
Me: oh no, that dough really did damage
Devon: never doing 500 again, lesson learned
Me: low and slow-ish next time
Devon: exactly, still cleaning flour off the counter btw
Me: that stuff gets everywhere
Devon: for real, oh mom asked about you again
Me: tell her i said hi
Devon: she said she saved you some potato salad if you stop by after noon-ish this weekend
Me: oh tell her i love her, i might swing by
Devon: she'll hold you to that, you always demolish it
Me: no self control with that stuff
Devon: same as us with garlic knots
Me: did yours even make it home back then
Devon: absolutely not, ate em in the car
Me: same lol
Devon: so bad news about next week
Me: oh no what happened
Devon: boss just put me on late shift next friday the 23rd
Devon: like i have to stay till close, no way i can make 6
Me: ugh seriously? you were supposed to be off on time that day
Devon: i know, no chart hell but now this. can we move our pizza to sunday the 25th instead?
Me: like two days later?
Devon: yeah same time same place, just sunday instead of friday
Me: oh that works for me, i'm free sunday
Devon: you sure? i felt bad asking last minute
Me: nah it's fine, 6 at Luigi's still?
Devon: yeah 6 at Luigi's on 5th street, just sunday
Me: yeah that works, garlic knots can wait two days
Devon: thank you, i was stressing about having to cancel
Me: no way, we need that pizza after this week
Devon: fr, i'll text when i'm parking like usual?
Me: yeah and i'll grab a table if i'm first
Devon: perfect, back lot parking still easier right
Me: yep, even sunday 5th is kinda annoying by the bank
Devon: those cones are permanent at this point
Me: for real, leave a little early and it's fine
Devon: will do, no late shift sunday thank god
Me: good, so sunday the 25th then, not friday
Devon: yep friday is dead, sunday is the plan
Me: cool, enjoy your toast tonight lol
Devon: elite dinner once more, enjoy your soup-not-toast era",
  "writer_note": "Kept the evening at-home voice with cats, traffic, and potato salad chatter, then had Devon cite the late shift on the 23rd to propose the 25th, with Me accepting the same 6pm Luigi's plan so the date swap stays clear without a formal recap."
}
